data.summary: NetzMuster GmbH informs David Muster (customer number NM-2291044) that the monthly base price of the "Muster DSL 250" internet tariff will rise from 39.99 € to 44.99 € as of 01.04.2026, and points out a special right to terminate the contract early because of this change.
data.explanation: Your internet provider is raising the monthly price of your tariff by 5 €. Because of this increase, German telecom law (§ 57 TKG) gives you a special right to cancel the contract early without notice and without extra cost, within a limited period after you received this letter — the app will show you the exact deadline for that. If you do nothing, the higher price of 44,99 € simply takes effect from 01.04.2026 and your contract continues as before. If you want to switch providers, compare offers before deciding.
